content.title: Crime Prevention for Your Business
content.summary: The Crime Prevention for Your Business class is a two-hour session designed to educate business owners on current crime trends in Arvada, safety measures for their business and employees, and police response procedures. Classes are available upon request and will be scheduled based on enrollment levels; for more information, interested parties can call 720-898-6883.
content.body:
The Crime Prevention for your Business class is a two-hour class geared towards business. Topics include current crime trends in Arvada, how to safeguard your business, yourself and your employees, as well as police response procedures and what to expect.

For more information or to request a class please call 720-898-6883. Please note, classes will be scheduled upon request and conducted based on enrollment levels.
